title: two files of one layer with the same id are one build: the first file by name wins and the second is not listed
source: intended: builds come from the repo's jitso/builds folder and from drafts (docs/decisions.md, The v0.1.0 cut)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers, narrowed by the v0.1.0 cut). Shadowing is by id, also inside one layer: when two files of the project's jitso/builds/ carry the same id, the first by file name is the build of that id and the second is never listed or launched.

stdout.regex: (?m)^- dup: claude-haiku-5-5 low\. FIRST file by name of the project\. requires: nothing$
